silence.checkbox: Don't ask again for this action

removeDraftRate.title: Remove this rate?
removeDraftRate.message: The rate row is removed from the draft rate plan.

resetTypography.title: Reset typography?
resetTypography.message: Typography settings return to their defaults.

clearStream.title: Clear the stream?
clearStream.message: This removes the lines shown so far. New lines keep arriving.

resetInputs.title: Reset all inputs?
resetInputs.message: Your changes return to their default values.

clearEditor.title: Clear the editor?
clearEditor.message: This removes the current text from the editor. It can’t be undone.
